findings.obs_text: In Gen 41:31 follow stands two words after by reason of and describes the famine it governs: the famine that comes after. The data gives the one English word three codes at the same place, H0310A (after), H1931 (it) and H3651C (so).
In 2Ti 1:6 remind (G0363) stands directly after for this reason, which governs it: the cause comes first and the reminder to rekindle the gift follows from it.
findings.grounds: For this reason I remind you

findings.obs_text: In 1Ti 1:16 mercy (G1653) stands two words before for this reason, which gives its purpose: Paul received mercy, and the reason phrase opens why.
findings.grounds: I received mercy for this reason

findings.obs_text: In Jam 3:17 mercy (G1656) stands two places after open to reason, the next quality in the list of the wisdom from above.
In Act 17:17 devout persons (G4576) are among those reasoned with: they stand five words after reasoned, joined to the Jews as the hearers in the synagogue.
findings.grounds: with the Jews and the devout persons

findings.obs_text: In 1Pe 3:15 holy (G1161) stands eight words before reason, in the clause that comes first: Christ is set apart as holy in the heart before the readiness to give a reason.
findings.grounds: honor Christ the Lord as holy

older.finding: holy as the godliness, devoutness or reverence of a person, a state toward God or toward what is right
older.reason: it states a face of the holy and godly words; the godly collection owns it

findings.obs_text: In Luk 9:47 hearts (G2588) stands two words after reasoning and names where the reasoning is: it is the reasoning of their hearts.
In 1Pe 3:15 hearts (G2588) opens the verse, eleven words before reason: the heart is where Christ is honored, and the reason is given outward to the one who asks.

older.finding: holiness of the inner seat: spirit, soul and body kept blameless (1Th 5:23)
older.reason: it states how the inner seat is kept holy; the heart collection owns it

findings.obs_text: In Dan 4:34 honored (H1922) stands six words after reason, among the acts of worship that follow its return.
In 1Pe 3:15 honor (G0037) and respect (G5401) frame the reason: Christ is honored in the heart before it, and the defense is made with respect after it.

older.finding: the fear root rendered respect, toward people
older.reason: it reads the fear words rendered respect; the fear collection owns it

older.finding: have no fear of them and with respect: one word, two verses apart (1Pe 3:14-15)
older.reason: it reads the fear words of 1Pe 3; the fear collection owns it

older.finding: a face of the fear words: awe, respect or reverence toward people
older.reason: it states a face of the fear surfaces; the fear collection owns it

older.finding: the Greek fear words G5401 and G5399 rendered respect (Rom 13:7, 1Pe 2:18, 1Pe 3:15)
older.reason: it reads the fear codes rendered respect; the fear collection owns it

findings.obs_text: In Act 28:20 hope (G1680) stands nine words after for this reason, in the clause that gives what Paul is bound for: the hope of Israel is why he wears the chain.
findings.grounds: because of the hope of Israel

findings.obs_text: In 1Pe 3:15 hope (G1680) is what the reason is given for: it stands two words after reason, which accounts for it.
In Jam 3:17 impartial (G0087) stands six places after open to reason, in the same list of the qualities of the wisdom from above.
In Mar 12:24 know (G6063) stands two words after the reason and gives its content: they are wrong because they do not know the Scriptures nor God's power; the not knowing is the cause.
findings.grounds: because you know neither the Scriptures

findings.obs_text: In Luk 9:47 knowing (G6063) stands directly before reasoning and takes it as its object: Jesus knows the reasoning of their hearts.
findings.grounds: knowing the reasoning of their hearts

findings.obs_text: In 1Th 3:5 learn (G1097) stands six words after for this reason, in the purpose of the sending: Paul sent to learn about their faith. WordNet relates the subgroup to this collection through conclude, a synonym; the verses show know and learn instead.
findings.grounds: I sent to learn about your faith

findings.obs_text: In 1Th 3:5 labor (G2873) stands fifteen words after for this reason, in the fear that moved the sending: that their labor among them would come to nothing.
findings.grounds: our labor would be in vain

findings.obs_text: In 1Jo 3:8 works (G2041) is the object of the purpose the reason introduces: the devil's works are what the Son of God appeared to destroy.
In Dan 4:34 lives (H2417) stands seven words after reason and describes God, the one honored once reason returns: he lives forever; it is not joined to the reason.

In Dan 4:36 glory, majesty and splendor (H3367, H1923, H2122) return together with reason, joined to it by the same verb, and greatness (H7238) closes the verse: the return of reason opens the restoring of the king's rule.
findings.grounds: my majesty and splendor returned to me

findings.obs_text: In Act 24:25 present (G3568) stands thirteen words after reasoned, in Felix's reply: he sends Paul away for now; the reasoning is cut short.
In Act 18:14 open (G0455) stands fifteen words before reason, in the opening clause: Paul was about to speak when Gallio answered; the reason is Gallio's, not Paul's.
In 1Th 3:5 vain (G2756) closes the verse, eighteen words after for this reason, in the fear that moved the sending: that the labor would be empty.
